artifact.title: CineGlobe Script Analyzer + Production Cost Engine Canonical Architecture

canonical_decisions: The Script Analyzer is a production-planning engine; it does not decide incentive qualification or replace the optimizer.
There is one evidence-progressive production model and one canonical budget lineage. L1, L2 and L3 are maturity states, not separate engines.
DocumentVersion is the immutable physical-source authority. ScreenplayDocument and BudgetDocument remain typed projections linked to it.
Actual and estimated budget inputs remain distinguishable. Parsed BudgetLineItem rows are immutable source observations; canonical BudgetLine rows select effective values and preserve lineage.
Deterministic facts cannot be silently overwritten by AI. AI assertions are staged evidence until precedence and confirmation rules select them.
AI never supplies rates, FX, fringes, arithmetic, or incentive economics.
The first implementation is a generic-project end-to-end vertical slice that reaches the existing optimizer without using LittleUtopiaState as its source builder.
Current static local-cost profiles remain usable only as explicitly labeled Tier C indexed/default estimates, never as production-grade actual rates.

steps.action: Use universal ingestion to create Document/DocumentVersion with checksum, source and confidentiality. Dispatch by semantic category rather than creating BudgetDocument for every file.
Phase 1 supports text-based screenplay PDF and plain text. Preserve page boundaries, character offsets and raw text hash. Failed/scan-only PDF is blocked, not guessed.
Extend screenplay_parser.py to normalize scene boundaries, page eighths, scene numbers, INT/EXT, day/night, headings, character cues and dialogue linkage.
Write version-scoped Scene, Character and objective SceneElement records with source spans and parser version.
Through the manual Bridge, propose evidence-backed elements not reliably available from format structure; responses are staged and cannot change deterministic facts.
Interpret scale/complexity only where evidence exists; record alternatives, rationale and confidence, never rates or dollars.
Validate evidence spans against the source, merge identical assertions, expose conflicts and apply precedence. No model vote.
Queue only material low-confidence non-deterministic decisions, grouped by production approach rather than scene-by-scene.
Generate effective ProductionRequirements, ProjectFacts and LocationRequirements while preserving every original observation.

ai_cannot: change scene text or boundaries without a separately reviewed parse exception
silently convert absence of evidence into false
promote its own output to ACTUAL or USER_CONFIRMED

schedule_architecture.scope: Minimum cost-driver schedule, not a Movie Magic Scheduling replacement.
inputs: character appearances and confirmed availability constraints
deterministic_process: Compute scene work units from page eighths and explicit complexity modifiers; preserve each modifier source.
Group by confirmed production location/stage, unit and day/night, then enforce cast/special-element constraints.
Apply pages/day ranges by scale and work type; do not hide the assumption behind a single default.
Pack scenes into estimated ShootDays with reproducible ordering rules; identify moves and split/special-unit days.
Derive department prep/wrap/rental/holding ranges from schedule drivers and confirmed assumptions.
If an actual schedule is uploaded, keep the estimate as comparison evidence and select actual days by precedence.
explicit_non_goals: resource-level optimization matching Movie Magic Scheduling
schedule_architecture.underestimation_guard: Total scene work units must fit scheduled capacity; omitted prep/wrap, move, night, restricted-child/animal, stunt/SFX and special-unit burdens produce blockers or explicit ranges, never silent zero.

single_model_invariants: Every budget version belongs to one Scenario and has a maturity state, not an engine type.
Stable line_key identifies the economic concept across maturity versions.
An aggregate line may be replaced by child lines; only active leaves count, preventing double counting.
Before new evidence, child P50 values reconcile to the parent's P50. Evidence-driven deltas are separately recorded, never hidden as discontinuity.
Every line carries amount and provenance state plus low/base/high inputs; no line can silently improve its authority level.
Actual imported lines can supersede matched estimate lines while unmatched estimates remain visibly residual, not silently added or discarded.

level_1.name: RAPID_GLOBAL_ESTIMATE
level_1.purpose: Fast worldwide production comparison with limited inputs.
inputs: high-impact interpreted requirements or explicit UNKNOWN
Tier B/C benchmarks and jurisdiction indices
level_1.granularity: department-level active lines with fixed/local/indexable/routable/travel localization policies
outputs: optimizer P50 payload plus uncertainty warnings
acceptable_assumptions: global defaults when labeled and widened
level_1.readiness: Useful for comparison, not greenlight or line-producer budgeting.

level_2.name: PRODUCTION_INFORMED_ESTIMATE
level_2.purpose: Actionable departmental/subdepartment budget from a structured breakdown and schedule.
inputs: validated local benchmark/rate inputs where available
level_2.granularity: department, subdepartment and material account lines; quantities and durations derive from requirements/schedule

level_3.name: DETAILED_LINE_BUDGET
level_3.purpose: Near line-producer estimate and rigorous production comparison; not a Movie Magic replacement.
level_3.granularity: line item with quantity, unit, rate, duration, prep/shoot/wrap, overtime, fringe, rental period, allowance, currency, jurisdiction and component
level_3.validity_gate: Cannot claim L3-valid for a jurisdiction while material labor/rate/fringe inputs are Tier C/global default, stale beyond hard expiry, or UNKNOWN.

unified_L1_L2_L3_budget_architecture.uncertainty_method: Each uncertain quantity/rate/duration stores low/base/high and distribution class. A deterministic seeded simulation uses shared correlation groups such as shoot days, crew scale, location count and FX so totals are not naive sums of independent percentiles. ACTUAL values collapse P10=P50=P90. The estimate stores seed, engine version and input fingerprint.
unified_L1_L2_L3_budget_architecture.presentation_precision: L1 totals are rounded to a material unit and shown as ranges; L2/L3 may display line arithmetic but must keep source state and range visible.

selection_rules: Higher authority wins only when it addresses the same scoped field and effective period.
An unaccepted quote is candidate evidence, not ACTUAL_PROJECT_VALUE.
A newer lower-authority observation does not silently replace an actual/confirmed value.
User override creates an Override record; it never deletes original evidence.
Conflicting same-rank values remain unresolved until scope/date/source or user confirmation selects one.

budget_integration.duplicate_guard: A source checksum + document version + account/source row key can create at most one imported observation. Canonical matching activates either the actual line or estimated line for the same economic concept, never both without an explicit residual/split relationship.

source_merge_rules.case: script has 20 scripted locations; budget has 8 location accounts
source_merge_rules.resolution: Keep both facts because they measure different things. Actual budget amounts control cost lines; scripted location count controls requirements. Produce a coverage discrepancy and material confirmation if the budget may omit/location-combine material needs.

source_merge_rules.case: actual/confirmed schedule says 35 days; estimate assumed 30
source_merge_rules.resolution: Select 35 by precedence, preserve 30 as original assumption, recompute every duration-driven line and show the schedule/cost delta.

source_merge_rules.case: uploaded budget includes crew; model estimates larger crew
source_merge_rules.resolution: Actual budget amount remains effective. Raise an undercoverage discrepancy and compute a non-counting shadow delta. Add/revise cost only after user confirmation; never silently stack estimate onto actual.

source_merge_rules.case: script extraction conflicts with deterministic slugline or dialogue parse
source_merge_rules.resolution: Deterministic source parse controls. Store AI alternative as disputed evidence and queue only if malformed source makes it material.

source_merge_rules.case: two actual files claim to be current
source_merge_rules.resolution: Document.current_version/user selection controls; keep both versions and block canonical rebuild until current version is unambiguous.
Do not auto-add when the budget is actual. Flag missing coverage; estimates may remain as inactive shadow lines until authorized.
Retain every line, classify or mark UNKNOWN/MISC for review, and include it exactly once in reconciliation.

validated baseline rebased by category/jurisdiction index

localization_policies.rule: Use scoped quote/actual; no generic scaling.
Role/agreement/region rates and schedule duration; generic crew index only as L1 fallback.

Origin/destination/people/days determine cost; do not apply broad country multiplier.

local_cost_architecture.current_profile_treatment: location_cost_benchmarks.py becomes Tier C INDEXED_ESTIMATE/GLOBAL_DEFAULT input. Its HIGH/MEDIUM labels do not constitute validation because data_sources are empty.

tier_A.scope: Maximum 12-15 high-value/active producer jurisdictions selected by active-project use, optimizer recommendation frequency and material spend; initial candidate queue includes MU, MT, GR, GB, AU, US, CA, IE and NZ without implying data is already populated.
tier_A.data: real crew/agreement/fringe tables plus key stage/equipment/location/travel benchmarks
tier_A.cadence: agreement/statutory rates checked on publication and at least quarterly; volatile hotel/airfare/FX monthly or closer to estimate date; vendor benchmarks at least quarterly
tier_A.hard_rule: expired agreement or hard-stale material rate cannot support L3 validity

tier_B.scope: Next jurisdictions with recurring comparisons but insufficient full rate cards
tier_B.data: reviewed category-level market benchmarks and regional ranges
tier_B.hard_rule: supports L1/L2 with ranges; not represented as role-level actual

tier_C.hard_rule: L1 only by default; widened uncertainty and explicit fallback chain

staleness_rules: Every rate has effective_from/until and last_verified_at.
Soft stale downgrades evidence state and widens uncertainty.
Hard expired rate is excluded; fall back to the next permitted tier or UNKNOWN.
Fallback never changes the displayed authority label.
Estimate snapshots retain the exact historical rate version, so later refresh does not mutate prior results.
rate_maintenance.maintenance_strategy: Prioritize data coverage by cost materiality and actual project demand, not by trying to hand-maintain every role in every country. Ingest structured agreement/rate-card versions and review deltas; do not overwrite historical versions.

Bridge_extension.decision: REUSE core manual Bridge; EXTEND provider-neutral script contracts.
Bridge_extension.beta_mode: Manual subscription workflow remains: export package -> independent provider response files -> import -> validation -> reconciliation -> human disposition. No paid API required.

package_schema.name: ScriptAnalysisPackage
fields: chunks with stable IDs and page/offset hashes
exclusions: cost targets that would bias extraction unless a bounded materiality re-review explicitly needs them

Bridge_extension.persistence: Validated responses create staged EstimateEvidence/SceneElement observations. Reconciliation or user action may select an effective value; raw/provider evidence remains immutable.
Bridge_extension.provider_independence: Provider adapters transport the same package/response schema. No provider-specific taxonomy, rate logic or business decision is allowed.

AI_EXTRACTION: evidence-backed production elements not structurally encoded
USER_DECISION: union assumptions where not objectively fixed

multi_model_policy.default: One model at most after deterministic parsing; no model for facts already resolved deterministically.
second_model_triggers: provider assertions conflict on a material element
evidence span fails or supports multiple material interpretations
material category remains UNKNOWN after first analysis
multi_model_policy.materiality_default: Potential P50 effect >= max(USD 25,000, 0.5% of current budget/L1 P50), or >=1 shoot day, or a change to component routing/production location.
multi_model_policy.reconciliation: Compare assertions to primary text spans and deterministic facts. Stronger evidence/scope wins; models do not vote. If evidence cannot resolve, mark disputed/UNKNOWN and ask the user only when material.
multi_model_policy.cost_control: Batch only triggered scenes/elements, not the full screenplay through every provider.

confidence_model.separation_rule: Evidence state describes authority. Confidence describes extraction/estimate uncertainty. Neither is a project-risk score.
confidence_model.unknown_rule: UNKNOWN has no numeric effective value unless a separately labeled fallback is selected; absence of evidence is not false or zero.
confidence_model.range_rule: P10/P50/P90 describe estimate distribution, not success probability or legal risk. Actual values collapse the range; correlated drivers are simulated together using a reproducible seed.
confidence_model.rollup: Department/total ranges derive from line inputs and shared drivers; confidence labels are not averaged into an opaque score.

human_confirmation_model.queue_condition: Prompt only when all are true: potential cost/schedule/routing impact is material; effective evidence is insufficient or conflicting; deterministic/source resolution cannot answer it.
human_confirmation_model.materiality_default: max(USD 25,000, 0.5% of budget/L1 P50), one shoot day, or material component/location routing change
human_confirmation_model.grouping: Group by one production decision and all affected scenes, e.g. practical locations vs stage for 23 scenes, rather than one click per scene.
human_confirmation_model.priority: Sort by expected impact band, then number of downstream lines/components affected, then confidence. Never display a synthetic risk score.
human_confirmation_model.answer_effect: Creates USER_CONFIRMED evidence/Override, recomputes dependent schedule/budget/state, and retains prior AI/model values.

generic_project_state.builder: New CanonicalProductionStateBuilder replaces only LittleUtopiaState's production-specific input assembly for generic projects; it reuses downstream calculators.
build_rules: Fail closed on ambiguous current versions or unreconciled totals.
Use active leaf budget lines once.
Snapshot inputs immutably and fingerprint them.
Expose provisional state when material low-authority assumptions remain; never label it actual.
generic_project_state.handoff: CanonicalProductionState -> OptimizerHandoffAdapter -> existing discovery, structure composition, allocation, production normalization, incentive evaluation and ranking.

Little_Utopia_acceptance.non_requirement: Exact line equality is not required; the test is structural coverage, honest uncertainty, useful cost accuracy and stable downstream decisions.

failure_prevention_controls.control: Evidence spans/hash validation, staged state, deterministic-fact lock, reconciliation and material confirmation.
Budget formulas accept only persisted Rate IDs or explicit user project values; Bridge schema contains no economic-rate fields.
Mandatory localization_policy allowlist and category-specific index; GLOBAL_FIXED/PROJECT_SPECIFIC/NON_SCALABLE reject broad multipliers.
Major cast/rights/fixed deals default GLOBAL_FIXED; change requires explicit scoped override.
L1 range/rounding rules, authority labels and reproducible distributions; no dollar-and-cent presentation for default-driven totals.
Scene work-unit capacity reconciliation, pages/day bounds and explicit move/night/restricted/special-unit burden checks.
L2/L3 material departments require prep/shoot/wrap duration source or blocker.
Labor line cannot be L2/L3 complete without fringe applicability/value/UNKNOWN state; L3 blocks on material UNKNOWN.
Schedule/work-pattern creates OT assumption; labor lines require OT rule or disclosed range.
Immutable import key, stable line lineage and active-leaf-only rollup; reconciliation total must equal source plus explicit residuals.
Typed discrepancy records and shadow deltas; actual cost remains effective until authorized revision.
effective dates, verification timestamps, soft/hard staleness and immutable estimate snapshots.
Material queue and provisional-state blocker; P50 may be evaluated but final recommendation is visibly provisional.
Precedence selector, Override record, ProjectActivity history and source-version fingerprint.
Separate service-performed, goods-used, worker-residency and payer fields; payer alone never sets jurisdiction.
